design:
## Design tests

After the bench, the long hair and revision 32 were read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v034.md`, six pictures, six readers). In all three pictures of her seated reading the woman in yellow is a woman or a girl in a yellow dress, "a girl or young woman with dark tied-back hair, a yellow dress and red shoes sits on a wooden bench, reading a red book", and each reader also calls her "the woman". A hose and a floating box, which revision 31 kept apart, read side by side, and the windy garden draws nothing on water. The storm pointer by the washing reads first at the clouds, and the washing, wider of her arm than the cone, still came up as a second reading. No reading called for a new rule.
intro:
The thirty-first screen read all 83 pictures, the set's 21 and 62 probes: 874 of 885 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. All 64 templates pass the gate, for the first time since v0.29. With long hair the woman in yellow is "a young woman" on the bench where v0.33's reader saw a child, and `read_bench` reads in full. No picture pours water in the wind.

The set has two items under full marks, a bird's theft of a sandwich and the clouds of a park, both on pictures that differ from v0.33's at most in her hair. On the 26 pictures identical in both screens, 296 of 299 items scored the same, two moving up and one down.
screen:
Across all 83 pictures 874 of 885 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. The three scorers gave one, none and ten items under full marks, in 314, 282 and 289; seven of the ten are the clouds, in seven of the nine pictures of one reader who named nothing in the sky. The set's headline is all items 0.995 (0.988 in v0.33), with things at 0.990, actions at 1.00, inferences at 0.986 and contradictions at 1.00. Its two items under full marks are the bird on the tier-4 garden's bench, which "pecks at the sandwich" with the theft not said, and the tier-4 park's clouds, unnamed as in v0.33.

**A fifth retest.** 26 pictures, 14 of the set's and 12 probes, were identical to the pixel in v0.33 and v0.34. 296 of their 299 items scored the same; two moved up, a balloon let go of and a girl throwing bread to the ducks, and one down, a playground's clouds.

**Remarks were 3.13 a picture, 260 on 83 pictures**, from 2.40 to 4.50 a reader. On the 26 identical pictures they were 96 in both screens. So the changes are read picture by picture: the woman in yellow is "a woman (or older girl) with long dark hair tied back" on the park's bench, and no water falls in a windy picture. The washing is still offered as what a storm pointer points at, "to bring it in", now as what the rain will soak, and in the windy garden "the woman's pile of leaves stays neatly in place": both are on the v0.35 list.
redrawn: `read_bench`, v0.33's failure, is at 1.00 with long hair. `rain_coming` holds at 1.00 with the washing kept out of the cone, and `water_flowers`, `pan_watering`, `hose_water` and `sprinkler_package`, kept out of the wind, all hold at 1.00.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (51 in three, 5 in four, 4 in five, 2 in six, one in eleven and one in twelve), and all 64 pass, for the first time since v0.29. The lowest is `blocked_hose` at 0.92, as in v0.33, its half marks now on a new probe where the goat's hooves are "on or right next to the hose". The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: The garden, park and playground tier-4 cells placed on v0.33's seeds under revision 32, and v0.29 to v0.33's template set, forced on v0.32's seed, placed the street's again in 21 s. The tier-3 garden placed again on v0.33's seed. 14 of the set's 21 pictures came back identical to v0.33's, and the other seven differ only in the woman in yellow's hair. The five isomorphs came back, three of them identical, and the tier-4 one took 12 failed attempts, as in v0.33. The first probe pass left `walk_dog` and `dog_begs` short, and two more probes filled them. All 83 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 342 of 342.
calib: No field moved by 0.002 or more, so the priors are v0.33's.
